summary: ini lookup parameters: keys, allow_no_value (2.12), case_sensitive (2.12), default, encoding, file (default ansible.ini), interpolation (2.18), re for regex keys, section (default global), and type (ini or properties).
questions: How do I read an INI file with keys that have no value?
How do I disable interpolation in the ini lookup?
How do I match INI keys with a regex?
What section does the ini lookup use by default?

answer_card.title: ini lookup parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_terms` (required): key(s)
- `section` (default `global`), `file` (default `ansible.ini`)
- `type` (`ini` default or `properties` for Java properties)
- `default` (default `""`): value if missing
- `re` (default false): treat key as regex
- `allow_no_value` (alias `allow_none`, 2.12+): allow keys without `=`
- `case_sensitive` (default false, 2.12+)
- `interpolation` (default true, 2.18+)
- `encoding` (default `utf-8`)
